name: sethostname
description: Sets the hostname to the value given in the specified character array. The len argument specifies the number of bytes in the array, and it operates on the hostname associated with the calling process’s UTS namespace.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The character array containing the new hostname.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The number of bytes in the name array.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: len is negative or larger than the maximum allowed size.
The caller did not have the CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability in the user namespace associated with its UTS namespace.
